---
title: "Breakout room - Handed a dataset"
---

## Scenario

**Handed a dataset**: you’ve received data from Bioconductor’s ExperimentHub. What metadata or provenance would you expect that isn’t there?

## The dataset

> "All scRNAseq datasets have the import scripts in the package source code, e.g., <https://github.com/LTLA/scRNAseq/blob/master/scripts/zeisel-brain-2015/2023-12-14.Rmd>"

## Load R packages

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(scRNAseq))
```

## Fetch data

```{r}
sce.zeisel <- ZeiselBrainData(
  ensembl = TRUE, # use Ensembl identifiers rather than gene symbols (default: FALSE)
  location = TRUE, # include genomic coordinates (default: FALSE)
  legacy = FALSE   # pull data from gypsum backend, not ExperimentHub
)
```

## Display the object

```{r}
sce.zeisel
```

This is a Bioconductor [SingleCellExperiment](https://bioconductor.org/packages/SingleCellExperiment/) object.

## Assay names

```{r}
assayNames(sce.zeisel)
```

## Assays

All the assays in a `SingleCellExperiment`object have the same dimensions (rows, columns).

This object contains a single assay.

We show the first 10 rows (genes) and first 10 columns (cells) to limit the output size.

```{r}
assay(sce.zeisel, "counts")[1:10, 1:10]
```

The full dimensions of the matrix are (rows, columns):

```{r}
dim(assay(sce.zeisel, "counts"))
```

## Row names

Gene identifiers.

```{r}
head(rownames(sce.zeisel))
```

## Column names

Cell identifiers.

```{r}
head(colnames(sce.zeisel))
```

## Display gene medata

```{r}
rowData(sce.zeisel)
```

## Display sample metadata

Single-cell data: one sample is one cell.

```{r}
colData(sce.zeisel)
```

## Alternative experiment names

```{r}
altExpNames(sce.zeisel)
```

## Alternative Experiment: ERCC


```{r}
sce.ercc <- altExp(sce.zeisel, "ERCC")
sce.ercc
```
